title: Puck: register /config + /status handlers with the standalone CoAP server (replace lichen_coap_server_init(NULL))
description: Child 3 of b7z9.41 (spec/11-lci.md 17.7 R-11-050..053). lichen/apps/puck/src/main.c:522 calls lichen_coap_server_init(NULL) under CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_STANDALONE, so /config and /status answer 4.04. The resources are implemented+tested (lichen/tests/coap_config, coap_status_get; vectors lci_config.json, lci_status.json) but puck registers no handlers. Work: understand the standalone server's handler/provider contract (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_server.c + include), register the config/status handlers (and whatever provider struct they need) in puck main.c, mirror how the gateway or the modular (non-standalone) path registers them. Verify: puck native_sim build green + a runtime check on native_sim that GET /config and /status return content (2.05/4.04-as-appropriate per R-11-050 semantics — read the spec rows first) instead of 4.04; vectors must stay authoritative. Largest child — may decompose further if the provider contract is rich. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.41.
